items.text: Final report: Washington is without QB Marcus Mariota, RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt, OLB Javontae Jean-Baptiste and DE Charles Omenihu. WR Stefon Diggs, DT Javon Kinlaw and safeties Percy Butler and Tyler Owens are questionable. Terry McLaurin has no designation. Jayden Daniels starts.

San Francisco is without DE Nick Bosa, WR Deebo Samuel, S Marques Sigle and LB Garret Wallow; LB Dre Greenlaw's one-game suspension was upheld. WRs Mike Evans and Christian Kirk and DL Mykel Williams are questionable; FB Kyle Juszczyk could return.

adjust.reason: San Francisco loses Nick Bosa, Dre Greenlaw (suspended) and Deebo Samuel, more than Washington's two missing edge rushers and RB. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
